subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement/security steps — follow-up from discovery
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T16:15:00-08:00
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement/security steps — follow-up from discovery

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the time. Quick recap and a few asks so we can map next steps on our side: 

Recap:
- Use case: Personalized product recommendations across web + email, estimated peak throughput ~50 req/s, typical sequence lengths ~400 tokens.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency <200ms for developer-facing endpoints; cost target to be within 30% of current unit cost.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q1 (kickoff Jan).

Asks / next steps:
1) Could you share a simple stakeholder map or org chart with the economic buyer + security / procurement / legal contacts? Specifically we need the primary procurement contact, security owner for cloud/data, and the exec sponsor (economic buyer).
2) Any standard procurement timeline or PO/contract process we should expect? Are there templates or SOW requirements?
3) Will Acme require a security questionnaire (e.g., SIG, CAIQ) and if so who should we send it to?

I attached a short one-pager on our Dedicated offering to help with internal alignment. Happy to draft intro language if you want us to reach out to procurement/security directly.

Thanks — I’ll follow up next week if I don’t hear back.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Exec
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_dedicated_onepager.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecommerce.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@acmecommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement/security steps — follow-up from discovery

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Helpful.

Attaching a lightweight org chart and our procurement process doc — should give you a starting point. Top-level notes: 
- Economic buyer: Tom Weaver (CTO) — cc'ed.
- Procurement: procurement@acmecommerce.com (team handles PO/SOW).
- Security & Compliance: Julia Park (InfoSec Manager) — not on this thread; I can intro if needed.
- Legal: contracts@acmecommerce.com for redlines.

Procurement timeline: for deals of this size expect 3–6 weeks post-technical approval (depends on SOC2 evidence & contract redlines).

We do require a security questionnaire for pilots touching customer PII — we typically use the SIG-Lite or our in-house form. If you have a completed SIG-Lite, please attach. Otherwise send the questionnaire to procurement@acmecommerce.com and cc julia.park@acmecommerce.com after the intro.

See attachments: acme_org_chart_v2.pdf; acme_procurement_process.docx

Elena
Sr. Product Ops Manager
Acme Commerce
[Attachment: acme_org_chart_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: acme_procurement_process.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecommerce.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement/security steps — follow-up from discovery

Thanks Elena — this is perfect. Quick next steps from our side: 
- I’ll send a short SIG-Lite and our SOC2 summary to procurement@acmecommerce.com and request an intro to Julia Park (InfoSec).
- Marissa (copied) will coordinate a one-hour technical review with your ML infra and security teams — proposed week of Dec 14. Marissa, can you share availability?
- Can Tom confirm whether the executive sponsor prefers a short exec briefing (15–20m) vs. a deeper technical demo?

Example intro language we can use for procurement / security: "Hi [Name],
We talked with Acme about a Q1 pilot for personalized recommendations. Redwood Inference provides a production-first inference platform that can run in hosted, dedicated, or private deployments. We're sharing our SIG-Lite and SOC2 summary for initial review; we'd appreciate a short sync to align on security evidence and procurement steps.
Thanks,
Rishi / Acme team"

I’m attaching the SIG-Lite and SOC2 summary now.

Best,
Rishi
[Attachment: redwood_sig-lite_filled.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf]

Looks good — thanks for the SIG and SOC2. I looped procurement and Tom. Julia Park is out this week but I expect an intro next week.

Procurement requested a short list of pricing scenarios (pilot vs. 6mo pilot + reserved capacity). Can you send 2–3 pricing options and a sample SOW? Procurement will also request invoice terms (Net30/Net45) and PO instructions.

I penciled in a technical review for Dec 15 at 10am PT (invite to follow) — Marissa, please confirm.

Elena
